ground_truth_root_cause: The cloud-east-2 DNS zone file (deployed in sha d4a8301) was missing A records for the new mail relay hosts (mail.enom-cloud.internal), causing NXDOMAIN failures for all MX and SMTP hostname lookups. Compounded by sha e2b7c55 updating smtp_host to mail.enom-cloud.internal before DNS propagation was verified, and sha f0d1e77 removing legacy network routes simultaneously, all email delivery paths became unavailable. Additionally, the SMTP relay credentials and security group ingress rule for port 587 were not provisioned in cloud-east-2 prior to cutover.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately add missing A records for mail.enom-cloud.internal to the cloud-east-2 DNS zone and allow propagation (~5 min). 2. Open security group ingress rule for TCP/587 on the new mail relay host (sg-0a9f3d). 3. Provision and configure new SMTP relay credentials in cloud-east-2 and hot-reload the email-service configmap with updated smtp_user and password. 4. Verify SMTP AUTH success and monitor delivery success rate recovery. 5. Drain the accumulated queue and confirm replication lag resolves.
